summary: Backend-only re-test for the redesigned traveler-voice invite email HTML. Added a dedicated test module (test_email_html.py, 11 tests) importing `_render_html` directly and asserting content strings, font declarations, Google Fonts link, size < 100KB, no 'Comic Sans', tape-signer 'The'-stripping behavior, uppercase passenger/destination, and randomized flight/gate/seat patterns. Regressed the existing endpoint contract (send-invite HTTP 200, invalid email 422) and one collage template (magazine). Also ran the full previous suite. Result: 24/24 tests passed including a real end-to-end email send to sayanbhatt2005@gmail.com with a valid message_id returned.

minor.issue: The rendered footer separator is 'WANDERLY  //  WHERE EVERY TRIP BECOMES A STORY' (HTML entities). Visually correct, but the raw source does not literally contain the double-space form 'WANDERLY  //  WHERE EVERY TRIP BECOMES A STORY' called out in the acceptance criteria. Test asserts both tokens present and a regex covering the   separator. Not a defect, just a documentation/spec nuance.

critical_code_review_comments: email_service._render_html uses random.randint/random.choice at render time (non-deterministic). Fine for a live email but worth noting for tests — assertions use regex, not exact values.
email_service.py is ~450 lines and file is close to the 700-line threshold; consider splitting the HTML template into a Jinja/string module if it grows further.
Broad `except Exception` in send_invite_email_route re-raised as 502 with the raw error string in `detail` — safe here (POC), but avoid leaking internal SMTP messages in production.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py (new — generates test photos + adds backend to sys.path)
seed_data_creation: Generated 5 solid-color JPEGs at /tmp/test_photo_{1..5}.jpg (800x800) via conftest.py for the collage endpoint tests.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth flow in this backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full suite is 24 tests: 13 existing (health/docs, send-invite success + 422, collage: polaroid_scrapbook full + magazine/postcard/filmstrip/moodboard/film_photo + 400/422 cases) plus 11 new HTML-render tests in test_email_html.py. Sample photos are auto-generated by conftest.py so /tmp/test_photo_*.jpg no longer needs manual setup. The redesigned HTML renders at ~17KB, well under the 100KB budget. Real emails are sent to sayanbhatt2005@gmail.com on every run of TestEmailInvite::test_send_invite_success.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no issues found. All redesign acceptance criteria are met: boarding pass, passport-stamp SVG helpers, torn-tape signer with 'The/A/An' stripping, luggage tag, paper-plane CTA, postcard back, footer stamp; four fonts declared; Google Fonts link present; HTML under 100KB; no Comic Sans; passenger + destination uppercase; flight/gate/seat randomized per WA-XXX/A-F+digits/1-42+A-F contract.
